name: adapter-nuxt
description: Nuxt 3/4 adapter — maps the core-engineering patterns onto Nuxt: data fetching (useFetch/useAsyncData/$fetch), server routes & Nitro middleware, Nitro caching (routeRules/cachedFunction), and state (useState/Pinia). Use when building or reviewing a Nuxt app (e.g. companion-ai, astro-ai-landing). For Vue 3 + Quasar SPA, use adapter-vue-quasar instead.
